I'm Jordan's assistant at CloudVault Inc. We're trying to buy the domain cloudvault.io from a broker and things have gotten a bit messy. I've dropped all the relevant files in the workspace — there's a briefing document someone put together (it's a bit rough), and there's a full email thread with the seller.

We need you to go through everything and produce a complete, ready-to-use negotiation mandate and response plan in the file `negotiations/active/cloudvault_io_mandate.md`. This should tell us: what our confirmed parameters are (and flag anything that's still unclear or not confirmed), what the right negotiation stance and autonomy level should be, any red flags you spotted in the seller's messages, and what our next response strategy should be — including a full log of what has happened so far in the thread.

Jordan is travelling and needs this done properly before anyone sends another message to the broker.
